scope.label: adapter
scope.meaning: Code 0 to 9 selects both signs of 21474836 plus offsets -2 through 2. Codes 10 to 12 select -1, 0 and 1. Denominator is one. Each exact integer product 100L*n is representable as double; the observer uses all 64 raw bits.
